description: The road appears to have no continuous pedestrian sidewalk; the edges are mostly narrow paved shoulders/curbs with patches of grass and shrubs, and there are no visible curb ramps or marked pedestrian crossings. Traffic is separated from the pedestrian area only by the curb/edge, with a wide multi-lane roadway and no physical barriers; lighting is provided by tall streetlights along the median/roadside. Vegetation and trees provide some greenery but limited, intermittent shade, and there are few obvious pedestrian obstacles or accessibility features visible.
